profile.name: Lakmal Siriwardhana
profile.title: Full-Stack Developer & Systems Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack developer and systems engineer with a decade of hands-on experience spanning production web platforms, cross-platform mobile apps, and Windows systems-level development. Comfortable owning a product end to end: database schema, backend services, UI, release pipeline. Shipped a consumer Android app with 800K+ downloads and built cryptographic licensing and HWID authentication systems used in production. Equally at home in a Vue component and in a kernel-mode driver or a disassembler.

points: Lead delivery on client and in-house products across web, mobile and desktop, from scoping through deployment and support.
Architect and build production platforms with Vue 3, Node.js/Express, Flask and PostgreSQL, including e-commerce and SaaS dashboards.
Design secure authentication and licensing systems, covering JWT session handling, Argon2 password hashing and HWID-bound activation.
Own CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker, plus release, monitoring and incident response for live services.
Built and maintained internal and client-facing web applications alongside day-to-day systems administration.
Ran Linux and Windows server infrastructure: deployments, backups, networking, and hardware and network troubleshooting.
Automated recurring operational work with Python and Bash tooling, cutting manual maintenance effort.
Supported end users and handled chip-level diagnostics and repair on client hardware.
Started in Visual Basic, C# and C/C++, moving into Windows internals, reverse engineering and kernel-mode development.
Delivered freelance web projects while performing board-level laptop repair, including BGA reballing and power-rail fault diagnosis.

focus: Full-stack web development (Vue 3, Node.js, Flask, PostgreSQL)
Windows systems & kernel-mode development (C/C++, WDK, HWID authentication)
Cross-platform & native mobile (Flutter, Android, Room, Retrofit, Firebase)
Reverse engineering & binary analysis (IDA Pro, WinDbg, x64dbg, Ghidra, JADX)
DevOps & automation (Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux, Bash)

education.title: Self-directed study - computer systems & software engineering
education.detail: Ten years of continuous self-study across systems programming, application security and web engineering, applied directly in production work since 2019.
